_comment: Multi-object selection by SHAPE identity. Four same-colour, same-size objects: three identical I-trominoes plus one L-tromino (the odd shape). The odd-shaped object moves to the bottom-right corner; the rest are preserved. Size selectors decline (all size 3), colour selectors decline (all one colour), position selectors decline (the odd object is never a unique bbox extreme). Only a shape-identity selector (odd_shape) can name the acted-on object. Tests the structure can lift selection on the shape dimension, not just size/position/colour.
